retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist oil-painted scene featuring a retro-styled rocket and an astronaut in a vast desert under a bright blue sky.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, surrealist painting depicting a sleek, silver, needle-like rocket ship grounded in a flat orange desert. An astronaut in a white suit with red harness straps stands in the foreground, accompanied by a small primate, both casting long, sharp shadows toward the right. The horizon is a sharp line dividing the warm earth from a vibrant, slightly textured blue sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical rocket bisecting the horizontal horizon line
Astronaut and companion in the lower foreground providing scale
Long, dark horizontal shadows contrasting with the bright ground
Complementary color scheme of orange ground and blue sky
coreInvariants: Flat, featureless desert floor with scattered small shrubs
High-noon lighting creating long, sharp shadows
Painterly texture throughout the sky and ground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The rocket is the central vertical anchor, occupying the middle third of the frame. The astronaut is small in the bottom center foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The silver rocket ship acts as the primary focal point due to its height and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the astronaut in the foreground, follows the shadow to the rocket, and then travels up the rocket's point into the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper sky and lower desert floor emphasizes the isolation of the subjects.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver-white rocket and astronaut suit with small red harness accents
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the ground and sky; high value contrast between the white subjects and their dark shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Flared, almost calligraphic ends on vertical strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' has a detached or very thin bowl connection
The 'Y' has a deep, curved fork
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative face to maintain focus on the surrealist art.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic, slightly weathered flared terminals

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surrealist oil painting of a silver needle-shaped rocket in a flat orange desert under a blue sky. Include an astronaut and a small monkey in the foreground casting long shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered white text at the top using a light, hand-lettered sans-serif font with flared terminals and wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the rocket needle-thin and silver?
Is the horizon line perfectly horizontal?
Are the shadows long and cast to the right?
Is the text white and widely spaced?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or copyrighted logos
Ensure the rocket design is generic retro-future rather than a specific historical model
postGenerationChecks: Check for painterly texture in the sky
Verify the astronaut has red harness details
Ensure the rocket has three distinct fins
Confirm the text is uppercase and widely tracked
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Oil Painting + Retro-Future Rocket + Desert Landscape + High Contrast Shadows + [Subject] + [Color Palette]
